title: In Other News: Anthropic Breach Dispute, UEFI Flaw Hits Most Servers, Cloudflare AI Data Leak
description: This report summarizes multiple cybersecurity incidents and vulnerabilities including a critical 16-year-old buffer overflow in UEFI firmware affecting most servers worldwide, a disputed AI-led intrusion at Anthropic, data breaches at the University of Copenhagen and ENGIE, and a Cloudflare AI data leak. The UEFI flaw allows local network attackers to execute code at high privilege during network boot. Anthropic disputes the scope of an AI-driven intrusion by a startup. The University of Copenhagen breach exposed personal and national ID data of over 500,000 individuals. Cloudflare fixed a cross-tenant data leak in its AI inference platform caused by a cache size mismatch and a bug in the inference engine. Other incidents include suspected Iranian cyberattacks on military freezers and attempts to breach the US Federal Election Commission systems.
